verdict.rationale: Column's docs show FBO/sweep/clearing/custom account types and pass-through 'two-legged' structures for managing funds on behalf of customers, and a community engineer praises the ability to create per-customer account numbers with individual permissions and limits pointing to a master account, matching the virtual-account/sub-account pattern. missing for 10: explicit documentation of unique routing-number issuance per virtual account and bulk/scale provisioning API examples.
